'''Bersabba''' was a [[XQ2 Platform]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
Bersabba was located near [[Abrihom]] and [[Cyrlus]] and was housing [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] [[Baker Squadron|Baker]]. The Z-95s and the platform were destroyed by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] launched from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Implacable (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Implacable'']]. The events surrounding the platform were recreated and used as a training simulator to train future [[TIE pilot]]s in the [[Combat chamber]], one of those pilots was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
